title: Build lines from the report note, on a phone and on an ineligible work order
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A work order carrying an inspection report note whose report recorded at least one Monitor/Not OK finding. Seed it: run and complete an inspection with a Not OK finding on a work order, which posts the inspection report note to that work order.
  3. Have one such note on an eligible work order (Estimate/Approved/In Progress/Review) and one on an ineligible work order (Complete/Invoiced/Paid/Declined). A phone (or narrow window) available.
custom_steps:
1. On the note, confirm a Build lines action sits alongside the existing view and download actions.
2. Press it and check it opens the Build lines flow: choose the target work order, then the lines draft and you press Add Lines.
3. On a note whose work order status is not eligible (Complete, Invoiced, Paid or Declined), check a new work order is created and the note stays put.
4. On a phone, confirm all note actions remain reachable, wrapping rather than overflowing.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The inspection report note offers a Build lines action alongside its existing view and download actions.
  • The action runs the same build as S2, including the choice of target work order.
  • All actions on the note remain reachable on a phone, wrapping rather than overflowing.
  • If the work order is not an eligible build target, the build creates a new work order and the note stays where it is.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9102 (S4 — Build from the inspection note on a work order); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S4; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R1: “The inspection report note will offer a Build lines action alongside the existing view and download actions”
  • S4-R2: “The action will run the build described in S2, including the choice of target work order”
  • S4-R4: “All actions on the note will remain reachable on a phone, wrapping rather than overflowing”
  • S4-E1: “If the work order itself is not an eligible build target, the build creates a new work order per S2-R5 and the note stays where it is”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
